mechanism.claim: When the full positive-correlation network of six liquid alt perpetuals newly separates into two unusually modular communities, crypto risk transmission is fragmented rather than governed by one market mode. During elevated BTC variation, follow the completed final-hour direction of the dynamically dominant community for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the larger-absolute-median-return community in the completed final hour
mechanism.why_distinct: HVAMST discards all but five minimum-distance edges and tests unique-node degree centralization. HVCMMI measures one spectral market-mode share, while correlation-fracture candidates aggregate pairwise changes. HVAMF instead retains every positive correlation edge, exhaustively maximizes weighted two-community Newman-Girvan modularity, and obtains direction only after the partition from the dynamically dominant module. It reuses no prior event or control and uses no BTC direction, volume, flow, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, or post-entry data.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent and exact network modularity its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: 04:05/12:05/20:05 UTC full-network fragmentation onsets are absent from Gross9 clocks

features.aligned_window: 96 exact epoch-aligned five-minute bars from 480 unique coherent bars_binance one-minute rows [D-8h,D) for BTC and six alts
features.alt_return: log(five-minute close/open), 96 observations per alt; each sample variance strict positive
features.correlation: six-by-six float64 sample Pearson correlation matrix, finite with unit diagonal
features.adjacency: off-diagonal max(correlation,0), zero diagonal; total undirected edge weight strict positive
features.partition_universe: all unordered bipartitions of six frozen-index nodes with both communities containing at least two nodes; the community containing frozen node index zero is emitted first
features.modularity: for each partition, sum over communities of internal_edge_weight/total_edge_weight minus (community_weighted_degree/(2*total_edge_weight))^2
features.unique_partition: one partition must have a strict float64 maximum modularity; exact maximum ties reject
features.modularity_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.community_final_hour_return: cross-sectional median, separately within each community, of member alts' sums of the final 12 five-minute returns; both medians finite and strict nonzero
features.dominant_community: community with strictly larger absolute final-hour median return; equal magnitudes reject
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared 96 BTC five-minute returns), finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid prior cannot trigger

clock.side: sign of dynamically dominant community final-hour median return
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent full-network community-fragmentation primitive selected from formula-absence and complete-source audit only; no prior candidate outcome selected its partition, side, clock, or gate

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, aggregation, correlation, adjacency, partition universe, modularity, tie rule, history, rank, threshold, variation, onset, dominant community, direction, clock, hold, subset, source, or control repair
